'''Christian Lapidge''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls104.htm Vapormatic 2000], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055924/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls104.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
